displayName: Spinal Cord Toolbox web app segmentation (sct-webapp)

readme.run: Segment the spinal cord with the web app's SCT models
notes: The spinalcord model is included; the run above needs no network connection.

Other tasks: graymatter, lesion_sci_t2, lesion_ms and spine. Download a task's pinned model once with sct-webapp download-models --task TASK (120 to 540 MB); every model is SHA-256 checked when downloaded and when loaded.
Outputs use the web app's formats and names: <task>_<stage>.nii masks and, for lesion tasks, <task>_lesion_metrics.csv. Native CPU and browser WebAssembly results can differ slightly.
sct-webapp is not the native Spinal Cord Toolbox and does not replace its sct_* commands; SCT analysis, DICOM import and manual mask editing use the web app.
Research software; inspect every mask. Imported source and converted SCT model weights retain NOASSERTION licensing.
